claude.rationale: This is a Chapter 11 reorganization in which the same corporate entity emerged: the plan "retain[ed] the pre-petition three-segment operating structure (Crude Oil, Products, U.S. Flag) and the Marshall Islands subsidiary vehicle (OIN)" — so the customer-facing fleet/product (T4) and the operational ship-management processes (T5) remained together within the same surviving parent, yielding no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). The processes stayed with the same operating structure and the roughly 3,600-employee workforce/segment operations were not severed from the operations that run them, so gap_56=0; the only management discontinuity was the board replacement and departure of the independent-contractor CRO (T6 coded partial), which is a governance change, not a structural stripping of operations from people. No Tier-1 fusion is documented; ownership crossed only at the capital-structure level (old equity cancelled, new securities issued) while the operating enterprise continued whole.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a Chapter 11 reorganization where the parent company and its subsidiaries emerged intact. The pre-petition operating structure, vessels (T4), and operations (T5) were retained, and there is no evidence of a structural mismatch between products and processes (gap_45 = 0) or processes and organization (gap_56 = 0) at closing.

openai.rationale: The structural summary states that the surviving parent retained the pre-petition three-segment operating structure and the OIN vehicle holding the International Flag operating entities, while the exit facilities remained collateralized by the corresponding U.S. Flag and International Flag asset pools; this documents no product-versus-process separation at closing, so gap_45 is 0. Although all former directors ceased service, nine new directors immediately began service, while the operating structure remained in place; the slice documents governance replacement but no closing-stage separation of operations from the organization running them, so gap_56 is 0.
